# B. Rho — The Shape of Scenes

## Thin
Sentence length and scene turns are tempo controls: a long sentence slows and lets the moment breathe
(grep: `slows the tempo and lets a moment breathe`), and ending on a question rather than an answer
carries momentum forward (grep: `End a scene on a question, not an answer`).
